# Aldric Voss

![[aldric-portrait.png]]

Aldric commands the harbour watch in [[Port Verity]] and answers to the [[Silver Hand]]
on matters of trade security. He and [[Mira Sable]] have history: they served together
before the Silver Hand recruited him.

Rank:: Captain
Faction:: [[Silver Hand]]
Reports to:: [[Mira Sable#Council Seat]]
